svg.title: A1 - Plan vehicle redistribution among Hubs (UC-M4-01, FR-10.1 to FR-10.3)

g.text: A1 - Plan vehicle redistribution among Hubs (UC-M4-01, FR-10.1 to FR-10.3)
Compute effective vehicles, expected pickups and returns,
need and surplus for every Hub (per vehicle type)
Any Hub with need > 0 and any Hub with surplus > 0?
Sort destinations by urgency (highest first), then Hub ID
Pick source s: nearest, then largest surplus, then Hub ID
q = min(need(d), surplus(s), free spaces(d) - buffer, max per task)
q > 0, s keeps its safety stock,
Select q vehicles at s (Available, battery OK,
no reservation soon, not in another task)
update need, surplus and free spaces
Reduce q to the vehicles found, or drop the pair
need(d) > 0 and a source with surplus exists?
Sort tasks (priority, then task key) and show them to the Operator
